name: mathlib_benchmark_v09_new
description: A benchmark derived from the mathlib (Lean) corpus that measures a model's ability to predict or generate formal proof steps and tactics. It evaluates models on tasks related to formalized mathematics and theorem proving, requiring both mathematical understanding and precise code-style output in a proof assistant language. The benchmark is intended for assessing models used in automated theorem proving and proof assistant tooling.
reputation: Well-regarded within the formal theorem proving and proof-assistant research community, though relatively niche compared to general NLP benchmarks.
